name: Cursor Agent SDK
description: Lets developers define, test, evaluate, and deploy agents as Markdown and TypeScript code, on Cursor-managed hosting or their own infrastructure.

skills.name: Scaffold Agent Projects
skills.description: Creates a project of Markdown instructions and TypeScript tools with agent-sdk init, then runs it locally with agent-sdk dev.

skills.name: Run Evals
skills.description: Discovers and runs eval cases from the project's evals folder, locally or as remote batches, with agent-sdk eval.

skills.name: Deploy And Manage Agents
skills.description: Deploys agents to Cursor-managed hosting, then lists, rolls back, stops, or deletes deployments and manages their secrets.

skills.name: Connect Slack And GitHub
skills.description: Provisions Slack channel apps and forwards, replays, and inspects GitHub webhooks so agents can act in Slack and on pull requests.

skills.name: Serve Agents Over MCP
skills.description: Connects an MCP client to a running agent with agent-sdk mcp serve or mcp install.
